title: Interim poll creator-secret access control + voter input sanitising (closes F1 before login ships)
allowedImports: NO other imports. NO npm packages.
spec:
Create `app/src/lib/poll-access.ts` exporting EXACTLY these named functions (strict TypeScript, Node 20+):

1. `issueCreatorSecret(): string` — `randomBytes(16).toString('hex')` (32 lowercase hex chars).

2. `hashSecret(secret: string): string` — SHA-256 of the UTF-8 secret, lowercase hex (64 chars).

3. `verifyCreatorSecret(storedHash: string | undefined, presented: string | null | undefined): boolean` — returns false unless BOTH are non-empty strings. Compute `hashSecret(presented)` and compare with `storedHash` in CONSTANT TIME: both are hex strings, convert to Buffers (`Buffer.from(x, 'hex')`), return false if lengths differ, else `timingSafeEqual`. Passing the stored hash itself as `presented` must return false (it is hashed again). Never throw (wrap in try/catch and return false).

4. `resolvePollViewer(poll: { creatorSecretHash?: string }, presentedSecret: string | null | undefined): 'creator' | 'participant'` — 'creator' only if `verifyCreatorSecret(poll.creatorSecretHash, presentedSecret)` is true; otherwise 'participant'. A poll without `creatorSecretHash` is never 'creator'.

5. `sanitizeVoterInput(input: { voterName?: unknown; comment?: unknown; lovedSlugs?: unknown; removedSlugs?: unknown }, allowedSlugs: readonly string[]): { voterName: string; comment: string; lovedSlugs: string[]; removedSlugs: string[] }`
   - `voterName`: if not a string, or empty after trim => 'Family Member'. Otherwise trimmed, control characters removed, then truncated to 60 characters.
   - `comment`: if not a string => ''. Remove control characters (regex `/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g`, keep tab/newline), then truncate to 280 characters. (Do NOT trim away the length cap: the 280-char test input is 3 junk chars plus 500 'z'.)
   - `lovedSlugs` / `removedSlugs`: if not an array => []. Keep only string entries, lowercase them, keep only those present in `allowedSlugs` (compare lowercase), deduplicate preserving first-seen order.
   - A slug present in both lists is kept in `lovedSlugs` only (loved wins).

No default export. No other exports. No console output. No side effects at import time.
